_comment: Mechanical subset of the emission contract, plus the compact directive the Stop hook puts in its block reason (keep it in step with skills/emission-contract/SKILL.md's Directive). where = start (first paragraph), end (last paragraph), or anywhere. Regexes are case-insensitive unless ignore_case is false, and run on prose with fenced code, inline code, and > quotes removed. A pattern with max_count counts multiline matches and fires only above max_count in a message under max_words words.

patterns.message: opens with an offer to help

patterns.regex: \b(let me know if|feel free to|i hope (this|that) helps|hope this helps|happy to help)\b
patterns.message: ends with an offer or pleasantry
uses a banned tic word (delve, tapestry, testament to)
uses a banned tic phrase (it's worth noting, in today's ... world)
uses an angle-bracket placeholder in prose, which some terminals show as <word> (write N or the real value, or put it in inline code)
ends with a summary paragraph (In summary, To recap, To summarize, Overall)
ends with an offer of more work (I can also, Would you like me to, Want me to, Shall I, I can fix any of these, ... if you want); state the next step or ask the one decision directly

patterns.regex: \b(it'?s|it is|this is|that'?s|that is) not (just|only|merely|simply)\b[^.!?\n]{1,80}?(,|;|:|\u2014|\u2013| - )\s*(but\s+)?(it'?s|it is|this is|that'?s|that is)\b
patterns.message: uses the "it's not just X, it's Y" shape; say what it is
uses more than 3 headings in a message under 500 words; use plain paragraphs

directive: Lead with the outcome: the first sentence is the answer, the result, or the blocker
Report evidence, not effort: what changed, what you ran, what it showed; state a failure plainly
Size to the ask: one to three sentences for a quick question; headings only for three or more distinct parts
Specifics over adjectives: path:line, numbers with units, exact commands
End on substance: at most one concrete next step or one question; no recap, no offers, no pleasantries
Plain words: no tics (delve, tapestry, testament to, it's worth noting), no emoji
